text: Cooking merges creativity with exactness to become an art form. A successful meal starts when the correct seasoning is applied. One must first realize that taste depends not only on what goes into the pot but also on how it is handled. Adding or boosting flavor defines the act of seasoning itself. Salt, pepper, and herbs serve as standard choices; each one critically improves the food's taste. Simmering remains another vital method. This process means keeping ingredients in liquid at low heat for an extended time so that their natural flavors emerge.
